note: A fixed retrieval evaluation set for app/scripts/reembed.py, spec-doc6 section 7. Hand authored from the recruitment domain this platform retrieves over: resume-shaped documents, JD-shaped documents, and the queries a recruiter or the matching pipeline would actually issue. Fixed rather than generated, so a change in a score is a change in the embedding model or in the text that was embedded, never a change in the questions. NOT SCORED AGAINST A LIVE MODEL: no Voyage credential exists in this phase, and the numbers a real model produces are listed in VERIFICATION_PENDING.md as outstanding.

documents.text: Senior platform engineer. Ran Kafka clusters at 40k messages per second, owned partition rebalancing and consumer lag alerting, migrated three services off RabbitMQ.
Backend developer, two years. Wrote Kafka consumers in Java for an order pipeline, learned about consumer groups and offset commits from the team lead.
Database engineer. PostgreSQL tuning, autovacuum configuration, logical replication between regions, query plan analysis and index design for a 4TB estate.
Search engineer. Built hybrid retrieval with pgvector and tsvector, reciprocal rank fusion over semantic and lexical candidates, embedding pipeline on managed GPUs.
Infrastructure engineer. Terraform modules for ECS Fargate, RDS and ElastiCache, per-service scoped IAM policies, immutable ECR tags and digest-verified deploys.
Site reliability engineer. Kubernetes on EKS, cluster autoscaling, Prometheus and Grafana alerting, incident command for two Sev1 outages.
Frontend engineer. React and TypeScript, Next.js app router, server components, accessibility audits against WCAG AA and a design system in Tailwind.
iOS engineer. SwiftUI, Combine, offline-first sync with Core Data, shipped four App Store releases and cut cold start by 40 percent.
Android engineer. Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, coroutines and Flow, modularised a monolith app into feature modules.
Machine learning engineer. Fine-tuned transformer models for text classification, built an evaluation harness with stratified holdout sets and calibration curves.
Computer vision engineer. Object detection on edge devices, quantisation and pruning, ONNX runtime deployment on ARM.
Data engineer. Spark on EMR, Delta Lake tables, dbt models and Airflow orchestration for a 200 table warehouse.
Analytics engineer. SQL modelling, cohort retention analysis, experiment readouts and dashboard design for a product team.
Application security engineer. Threat modelling, SAST and DAST pipelines, secret scanning, wrote the secure coding guidance the platform teams follow.
Cloud security engineer. IAM least privilege reviews, VPC segmentation with no internet route to data subnets, KMS key policy design.
QA automation engineer. Playwright end to end suites, contract tests against recorded fixtures, flake triage and a quarantine policy.
Product manager. Owned a two-sided marketplace roadmap, ran discovery interviews, wrote the pricing experiment that lifted conversion.
Product designer. Design systems, dark mode token architecture, contrast auditing and motion specifications for a dashboard product.
Technical recruiter. Full cycle hiring for backend and platform roles, structured interview design, offer negotiation and pipeline reporting.
HR generalist. Onboarding, performance cycles, employee relations casework and compensation banding.
Financial controller. Monthly close, revenue recognition under Ind AS 115, statutory audit coordination and GST filings.
Enterprise account executive. Closed seven figure annual contracts in SaaS, MEDDIC qualification, multi-threaded stakeholder mapping.
We need a backend engineer in Python and FastAPI, async SQLAlchemy, Postgres and Redis, Celery for background work, comfortable owning a service end to end.
Platform engineer wanted for our streaming estate. Kafka, schema registry, exactly once semantics, consumer lag SLOs and capacity planning.
Reliability engineer. Kubernetes, Terraform, observability, on call rotation, blameless postmortems and error budget policy.
Frontend engineer. React, TypeScript, Next.js, design system contribution, accessibility and performance budgets.
Machine learning platform engineer. Feature stores, model serving, evaluation harnesses, GPU scheduling and cost control.
Data engineer. Build and own the warehouse: Spark or dbt, orchestration, data quality tests and lineage.
Application security engineer. Threat modelling, pipeline security controls, dependency and secret scanning, developer enablement.
Engineering manager for a platform group. Hire and grow a team of eight, own delivery, partner with product on roadmap and set technical direction.
